title: Measuring Dimensions of Self-Presentation in Twitter Bios and their Links to Misinformation Sharing

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting social media bio embeddings onto a partisan semantic axis (defined by endpoints like 'democrat' vs. 'republican') and correlating the projections with human survey judgments and network-based user ideology scores.
Projecting text embeddings of identities and bios onto an age-related semantic axis (defined by endpoints like 'young' vs. 'old') and evaluating the correlation with human perceptions of age.

Projecting text embeddings of identities and bios onto a gender-based semantic axis (defined by endpoints like 'mother' vs. 'father' or 'woman' vs. 'man') and measuring the correlation with human survey judgments.

Projecting text embeddings of identities and bios onto a religion-based semantic axis (defined by endpoints like 'atheistic' vs. 'religious') and evaluating the correlation with human judgments and associations with misinformation sharing behavior.
